The project is a university student residence, so proximity to schools and universities is clearly necessary. Per the 75th percentile of the education distribution (75.14, rounded to 75), the property should be in the top quartile for education access.
The user explicitly requires at least 850 sqm of gross floor area, so the explicit surface threshold is applied to surface_area.
